title: U.S. Biofuels Plant Production Capacity Report
summary: (Thu, 24 Sep 2026) The U.S. Biofuels Plant Production Capacity Report with data for all operating U.S. fuel ethanol, biodiesel, and renewable diesel fuel and other biofuels production plants as of January 1, 2026. Starting September 2026, this report consolidates the three individual reports on U.S. biodiesel, fuel ethanol, and renewable diesel fuel and other biofuels plant production capacity.
